run_shard_docs: run the shard_docs script to split a large document file into multiple shards respecting document boundaries
run_shard_docs_num_shards: run shard_docs with --num-shards to split an input file into N round-robin distributed shard files
review_main: review the main function that parses input file and num-shards arguments then distributes documents across shard output files
review_output_doc: review the output_doc inner function that writes a document to a specific shard file with proper newline separation
summarize_shard_docs: summarize the shard_docs script that splits a text file into N shards by distributing documents separated by empty lines
